credits.title: Priyanka! What's My Name?
credits.overview: After hitting a breaking point, drag superstar Priyanka is forced to reevaluate her life, identity, and relationships.

credits.title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer
credits.overview: When Blitzen announces his retirement on December 21st, a miniature horse has 3 days to fulfill his lifelong dream of earning a spot on Santa's team at the North Pole try-outs.

credits.title: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
credits.overview: After moving to New Jersey, Lola bags a coveted role in a school play, which earns her the wrath of Carla, the most popular girl in school, who will do anything to ruin Lola's life.
